mechanism_narrative: Persistent negative WORKPLACES mobility (mean -19.6% over four weeks) signals sustained remote work adoption. This reduces commuter foot traffic to retail zones, suppressing RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks relative to the baseline period.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM mobility (mean +25.95% over four weeks) reflects defensive shopping behavior and supply-chain anxiety. failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains above 20% for all four weeks ahead AND RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior 28-day mean.
